description: Advance story identity to Release 1265 and load the bounded qualitative light module after Release 1264.

replacements.old:
"ZORK1 PERILOUS AFFORDANCES / LET THE PLAYER BE WRONG GLULX for
  Zork I: The Great Underground Empire
  (c) Copyright 1983 Infocom, Inc. All Rights Reserved."

;"Repository-local Perilous Affordances. Release 1264 lets explicit destructive
  player choices reach authored consequences for the canonical lantern and rope,
  the Release 1263 fire screen, and the Release 1262 star-glass. It composes exact
  object authorities rather than adding a universal destruction or durability system."
replacements.new:
"ZORK1 CONSUMABLE LIGHT AND GRADUATED DARKNESS GLULX for
  Zork I: The Great Underground Empire
  (c) Copyright 1983 Infocom, Inc. All Rights Reserved."

;"Repository-local Consumable Light & Graduated Darkness. Release 1265 promotes
  the canonical lamp/candle countdowns, match and ivory torch, existing mine fire,
  and the authored grue colony into qualitative bright/weak/ember consequences.
  Binary visibility, canonical timers, and canonical grue danger remain authoritative."
